core: Glycerolipid (PA, DAG, TAG, phospholipid) synthesis and turnover
name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipase-driven triglyceride/phospholipid catabolism
rationale: All members concern synthesis, remodeling or breakdown of phosphatidate, acylglycerols and phospholipids; unlike the PC-synthesis and lipid-droplet storage confusables, the theme adds lipase activation, PDE3B-regulated lipolysis and TAG/phospholipid catabolism.

name: Nucleotide catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover breakdown and sanitization of (deoxy)nucleotides and pyrimidines plus thiopurine/abacavir/ribavirin handling; confusables instead emphasize purine biosynthesis/salvage or nucleoside transport.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK activation and negative-feedback ERK inactivation
rationale: Members span RAF/MEK/ERK/RSK activation (incl. MRAS-SHOC2 and MAPK mutants) and its dephosphorylation-based feedback shutoff, the latter distinguishing it from RAS/SOS/GAP-focused confusables.

qualifier: nicotinate salvage route, not de novo from tryptophan
name: Nicotinate-derived NAD+ salvage, turnover and NADP+ synthesis
rationale: Members concern nicotinate/pyridine nucleotide salvage, NAD+ breakdown and transport and NADP+ formation, distinct from the tryptophan-kynurenine de novo NAD confusable and the CoA/nucleotide confusables.

qualifier: promotion of keratinocyte migration and proliferation
name: Regulation of keratinocyte-driven wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members regulate epidermal cell spreading, keratinocyte/epithelial migration and proliferation and inflammation during wound healing, whereas confusables center on negative regulation of adhesion and migration.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis and respiratory complex III assembly
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly (incl. TCA enzyme maturation) and complex III assembly with matrix-side inner-membrane insertion, separating it from complex I/IV assembly and heme confusables.

qualifier: FRS2, SHC, PI3K and PLCgamma adaptor cascades
name: FGFR downstream FRS2, SHC, PI3K and PLCgamma cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR intracellular adaptor-mediated cascades (mainly FGFR1/2/4), whereas confusables add ligand-binding isoforms, FGFR3 and activating mutants.

qualifier: GAG and dystroglycan O-glycan synthesis plus lysosomal degradation
name: Glycosaminoglycan and O-glycan synthesis and lysosomal glycan degradation
rationale: Members cover GAG/proteoglycan biosynthesis, O-mannosyl/fucosyl/glucosyl glycosylation (dystroglycan, Notch), and lysosomal GAG and glycolipid degradation with their disorders, distinct from N-glycan/CDG and blood-group confusables.

name: Inhibition of integrin-matrix adhesion and Rho/Rac protrusive signaling
rationale: Members negatively regulate integrin signaling, focal adhesion, lamellipodia and Rho/Rac signaling, with IQGAP, invadopodia and RPTP signaling distinguishing it from epithelial-migration and wound confusables.

name: Microglial activation, DAP12 signaling and apoptotic-cell clearance
rationale: Members describe microglial activation, proliferation, amyloid-beta response and DAP12-linked phagocytosis of apoptotic cells, whereas confusables focus on amyloid-beta clearance and fibril formation.

name: NTF3-NTRK3 (TrkC) receptor signaling
rationale: All members are NTF3 activation of NTRK3 and its PI3K, RAS and PLCG1 outputs, distinguishing it from NTRK2/BDNF and NGF/TRKA confusables.

qualifier: germinal center Tfh help, plasma and memory B cells
name: Germinal center B cells, Tfh/ICOS help and plasma cells
rationale: Members are B cell, plasma cell and memory signatures plus Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, which distinguish it from generic B-cell surface and isotype-switching confusables.

name: Hair follicle maturation, anagen and nail development
rationale: Members concern epidermal appendage morphogenesis via hair follicle growth phase and nail development, unlike placode, tooth and keratinocyte-differentiation confusables.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: hormone-like ligands EPO, GH, prolactin, TPO, leptin
name: JAK2-STAT5 signaling by EPO, GH, prolactin, TPO and leptin
rationale: Members are signaling by single-chain hormone-type cytokine receptors (EPO, GH, PRL, TPO, leptin, with IL-11/IGF modulation), distinct from the IL-2/IL-6 family and FLT3 confusables.

name: Ras-family activation of RAF and p38 (MRAS-SHOC2, RIT/RIN)
rationale: Members are positive RAS-family signaling to RAF, MEK, RSK and p38, lacking the ERK negative-feedback and SOS/GAP members of confusables.

name: Response to toxic heavy metals and cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to cadmium, mercury, lead, cobalt and selenium, distinct from zinc/copper/iron homeostasis and MTF1-metallothionein confusables.

name: Leukotriene and pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis and breakdown of leukotrienes, lipoxins, resolvins, protectins and maresins, while confusables emphasize leukotriene/prostanoid receptors, hepoxilins or PAF.

name: Phosphorylation and ubiquitin control of p53 stability
rationale: Members link Ser/Thr (de)phosphorylation to p53 activity and degradation (COP1, Cdc25A turnover, DNA repair transcription), unlike G2 checkpoint, radiation and AKT confusables.

qualifier: oocyte spindle positioning and polar body extrusion
name: Meiosis I progression and oocyte spindle positioning
rationale: Members concern meiosis I entry and spindle assembly/localization with polar body extrusion (plus a spermatogenesis set), distinct from recombination/synapsis and chromosome-cohesion confusables.

name: Glycogen synthesis, glycophagy and their storage diseases
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis, lysosomal glycogen degradation and the corresponding GSDs and Lafora disease, whereas confusables cover glycogenolysis, glucokinase and G6PC defects.

qualifier: sarcomere assembly, dystrophin complex and neuromuscular junction
name: Skeletal muscle differentiation, sarcomere contraction and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members cover myogenesis, myofilament assembly and contraction, the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex and NMJ assembly, distinct from cardiac junction, calcineurin and SRF-target confusables.

name: Proteasome assembly and endogenous MHC class I antigen presentation
rationale: Members are proteasome assembly and endogenous peptide loading onto MHC class I, unlike confusables that focus on cross-presentation of exogenous antigen and viral MHC/CD4 downregulation.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic suppression of insulin and catecholamine secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z signaling inhibiting insulin and catecholamine secretion
rationale: Members are alpha-2 adrenergic, adenosine and Gz inhibitory cyclase signaling that suppresses insulin and catecholamine release, distinct from cardiac, smooth-muscle and cAMP/PKA confusables.

qualifier: PTK6 signaling and ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation
name: PTK6 signaling and ubiquitin-dependent ERBB receptor downregulation
rationale: Members combine PTK6 (BRK) signaling with ubiquitin/ESCRT-mediated ERBB endocytosis and PTEN regulation, while confusables focus on MET and ERBB adaptor activation cascades.

qualifier: creatine and nucleoside kinases with mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Creatine and nucleotide phosphotransfer with mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members are phosphocreatine/creatine metabolism, NMP/NDP phosphorylation and mitochondrial ADP/ATP translocation, distinct from nucleoside transport and NAD metabolism confusables.
